messages:
olga: dropped a compact row mock that tries to cram min/max steppers, an SLO chip, and a tiny burst trigger into one line. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/compact-rows-new (frame X)
ben: overall looks clean. small concern: users mistake burst for a status badge. make it an icon-button with a visible focus ring and a small caret so it's clearly interactive. :bolt:
sana: copy suggestion: use 'Short burst' instead of 'Burst capacity' across the UI. SLO label should read 'Latency target (ms)' for clarity. Also consider a subtle hover microline that shows est cost and p95 delta only on pool switch or hover.
marco: engineering: steppers must support left/right arrow increments + direct typing. debounce saves at 600ms and batch updates if multiple fields change. persist last-used burst quanta per pool (localStorage) so it's not jarring. compute cost delta client-side on pool switch to avoid extra API calls.
ivy: accessibility notes: 1) burst icon-button needs aria-label including pool name, 2) stepper value changes should be read by screenreaders via an aria-live="polite" region, 3) focus order must be min -> max -> SLO -> burst, 4) ensure contrast >=4.5:1 for 12px labels, 5) tooltips must be keyboard-focusable and <250 chars.
rachel: guardrail language: current wording 'We may scale below your min during outages' sounds harsh. suggest 'Autoscaling may temporarily reduce capacity under extreme conditions.' Also tooltip for short burst should show duration, est tokens/min, and est cost/min.
olga: great feedback 10 I'll update mocks: make burst icon-only with accessible label and caret, add a 1px divider between steppers and burst, show hover microline for cost/p95, implement persisted burst quanta, and add the a11y checklist to the PR template. will push v2 tomorrow morning. :rocket:
